We have designed a GNN model inspired by CHGNet model [ 6] and a covariant model [ 13] to predict the EAD from atomic species and positions.
This model contains ∼315k trainable parameters and automatically ensures the required translational, rotational and permutational invariance (See Appendix B for detail of the model).
CLM-MAT-0030.statement: The GNN model used for predicting EAD contains ~315k trainable parameters.
